title: I made a free cyberpunk arcade shoot 'em up for Android — Neon Cyber Shooter is live on itch.io
author: ZaDevLabs
selftext:
Neon Cyber Shooter — a free vertical scrolling shooter (shmup) for Android, just went live on itch.io.



Fast arcade action built for one-thumb play: drone swarms, multi-phase bosses, laser grids, ship upgrades + a Neural Skill Tree, haptics, and a global leaderboard. Works fully offline, portrait or landscape. Solo dev, heavily inspired by classic neon cyberpunk arcade games.



🔗 [https://z-dev-labs.itch.io/neon-cyber-shooter](https://z-dev-labs.itch.io/neon-cyber-shooter)



It's an APK download (\~31 MB, Android 7.0+). Feedback would be hugely appreciated — especially on difficulty pacing and controls. If you try it, drop your high score! 🎮
